definitions.explanation: The act of responding to or dealing with customers, visitors, or inquiries.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}の{応対|おうたい}は{丁寧|ていねい}にしてください。
お{客|きゃく}さまへの{応対|おうたい}が{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.english: She's good at dealing with customers.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくて{応対|おうたい}が{雑|ざつ}になってしまった。
examples.english: I was busy and my handling became sloppy.

notes:
USAGE: {応対|おうたい} focuses on how one responds to or deals with people, often emphasizing manner and quality of interaction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{応対|おうたい}する (to deal with, to respond to)
・{応対|おうたい}が{良|よ}い/{悪|わる}い (good/bad service)
・{電話|でんわ}{応対|おうたい} (telephone reception)
・{窓口|まどぐち}{応対|おうたい} (counter service)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{応接|おうせつ} - receiving guests (more formal, hospitality)
・{対応|たいおう} - response, handling (broader, includes non-personal situations)
・{接客|せっきゃく} - customer service
